posts.meta_description:
27K likes, 364 comments - prernachhabra on January 15, 2025: "We’ve named our daughter Prisha (प्रिशा). Derived from sanskrit, Prisha translates to “God’s gift” .. which ofcourse she is for us!❤️☺️
sharing a few snippets from her 2 month birthday. 

As first time parents, the past couple of months have been quite hard.. I’ve had major brain fog from all the sleep deprivation.. pain in wrists from holding her.. breastfeeding has been a journey in itself.. 
Infact, when I look back at these 2 months it feels like this is definitely the hardest thing I have ever done!
And then, she gives this gorgeous, innocent toothless smile… in an instant I forget everything and start cuddling this bundle of joy.. 🥰 🧿

#whataphaseoflife #postpartum #prernachhabra #stylinginspiration".

posts.meta_description:
45K likes, 2,417 comments - prernachhabra on November 2, 2024: "Last Sunday morning we welcomed a baby girl 💕🥰😇🙏🏻

The entire process of delivery and labour pains had me wondering - “how have women been doing it and that too multiple times” 🥹🥲

Anyhow now that we’ve made it to the other side of the finish line (yes it does feel like that 😅) the excitement is such that the sleepless nights aren’t bothering me for now 😄🥹

It feels surreal to see a tiny human in my hands and to think she came out of me 🥹🥹🥹🥹 the heart is full of gratitude and only gratitude. Thank you for all your kind wishes and blessings 😇❤️🙏🏻🧿

#prernachhabra #pregnancydiaries #blessed #grateful #stylinginspirations #newborn #newmom".

posts.meta_description:
25K likes, 290 comments - prernachhabra on October 14, 2024: "Sharing the final two series of the images in the maternity shoot 🤰💕🧿
Hope this answers your most asked question from yesterday “where’s your husband?” 

Now, those of you who’ve been watching me on #youtube would know that my husband is a reserved and quiet person in general. One who is happy to support his wife in all her extroverted adventures but seldom enjoys being on camera 🙈.. which is why when we were working on the brief for his pictures “Shadow Photography” seemed like a great idea! For picture 3 (the one where he is kissing the belly) my expressions tell you how amazed I was when he agreed to pose for it 😄

As for the other look (picture 1) we call it “Embracing Transformation”.. the use of butterflies 🦋 adds so much to these images & is symbolic of new life 🙌🏽 it has to be my favourite 🥰🫶🏼

Again a huge huge thanks to @youyou_zhou_ for understanding my vision and very specific requests. It was quite the experience working with the fabulous team!

Art Direction and Styling: @youyou_zhou_ 
Photography: @rosselladmn 
MUA: @mua.genie 
Hair: @artist_marco_coluccio_ 
Outfits: @hausofra

posts.meta_description:
34K likes, 618 comments - prernachhabra on October 13, 2024: "With my job I’m always creating looks.. so when the thought of a maternity shoot came up I wasn’t sure if it was needed. 
So when I finally did decide to do it, I knew it had to be different and “concept led” .. something that has an editorial touch to it.. Sharing two of the four looks with you all today.. 

For the first one (purple and pinks) we call it THE PEARLS OF JOY. 
It’s the bliss that this phase has brought us, it has aligned me to my feminine side more than ever before.. almost like I’m living a dream 💭 

The second one in the yellow free flowing dress is called the GOLDEN BLOOM. It is a series of shots with my mum. We kept the shoot a surprise for her and the poser she is .. you can imagine how excited she was to know that’ll she’ll be a part of the shoot 🥰  Grateful to have her by my side! 😇
 
A huge thanks to the team for such stunning imagery ☺️
Art Direction and Styling: @youyou_zhou_ 
Photographer: @rosselladmn 
MUA: @mua.genie 
Hair: @artist_marco_coluccio_ 
Outfits by: @hausofra (the movement in your outfits has brought these images to life, Raahim 😇)

#prernachhabra #stylinginspirations #pregnancy #maternityshoot #pregnancydiary #marernityphotography #maternityfashion #maternitypictures #pregnancydiaries #maternityshoots #london".

posts.meta_description:
17K likes, 137 comments - prernachhabra on October 7, 2024: "Officially the 9th month has started and as much as the delivery process makes me nervous I’m supremely excited to meet our little one. The past few months have been quite the roller coaster ride. On some days I’d feel extremely energetic and the next I’d lie in bed the whole day being emotional for no real reason, haha.

As some of you might know, before I started my content creation/ influencer (whatever you wanna call it!) journey I used to work at Fabindia. It is at this amazing organization that I developed a taste for Indian handicrafts like the Ajrakhs, the Indigos, the Applique .. and visits to the handicraft clusters made me realise the kind of hard work that goes behind such craftsmanship. Coming to the point, since then I’ve had the opportunity to work with multiple brands in this category and very recently I got to work with @maaticrafts (a brand that I’ve long admired for their contemporary designs and a strong focus on delivering quality products). Even my mum is in awe of their pieces and in general very excited that they all fit her as well.. haha!!

I’d like to believe that it’s our baby who has brought us this good luck and also tons of energy for her mum to continue working during this time. Let’s see what’s in store for the next few weeks and finally when our Diwali baby decides to arrive. ❤️🥰💕

#prernachhabra #stylinginspirations #pregnancy #pregnancythoughts #pregnancyootd #pregnancyfeelings #1sttimemum #pregnancyfashion #saree #indianwear #smallbusiness #pregnancyjourney #ethnicwear".
